rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: After the sitting resumed at 17:02, President Motlanthe told the House that he intended appointing the Cabinet, beginning 'For the position of Deputy President, Mrs Baleka Mbete'.

locator.heading: STATEMENT BY PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC IN TERMS OF RULE 106

rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The Speaker then said that, now that the President had expressed his wish that she occupy the post of Deputy President, she rose to vacate the post of Speaker; the Deputy Speaker later announced the Speaker's resignation 'with immediate effect' and the Chief Justice presided over the election of a new Speaker.

locator.heading: RESIGNATION OF SPEAKER (Announcement); ELECTION OF SPEAKER OF NATIONAL ASSEMBLY

rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: Responding members spoke of her as the incoming Deputy President: one asked whether responses were to 'Ms Mbete, the Deputy President'; the IFP congratulated 'the hon Mbete on her appointment as Deputy President'; the UCDP congratulated her 'on her nomination as the Deputy President'; and the FF Plus spoke of 'this wonderful opportunity she is being given to become the Deputy President'.
